details: Include QtSerialPort in the Qt installation step. Add the QtSerialPort archive/module to the list of Qt components to download and install for Windows and macOS runners.
Install Qt SerialPort development package in Ubuntu 18.04 Docker image. Update the apt-get install line to include 'libqt5serialport5-dev' and ensure 'libqt5serialport5' is present for runtime.
Install Qt SerialPort development package in Ubuntu 20.04 Docker image (add 'libqt5serialport5-dev' and runtime lib as needed).
Install Qt SerialPort development package in Ubuntu 22.04 Docker image (add 'libqt5serialport5-dev').
Install Qt SerialPort dev package in Oracle Linux 7 image. For example, add 'qt5-qtserialport-devel' via yum/dnf.
Install Qt SerialPort dev package in Oracle Linux 8 image (e.g., 'qt5-qtserialport-devel').

Include QtSerialPort DLL in Windows package. Copy Qt5SerialPort.dll (or Qt6SerialPort.dll) into the build output or installer. If using windeployqt, ensure it’s executed so that QtSerialPort is pulled in.
Add libqt5serialport5 as a dependency in the Debian package control file (or equivalent packaging script). Ensure the built .deb declares this dependency.
Include libQt5SerialPort.so in the AppImage. Add the QtSerialPort library to the AppImage bundle configuration so it’s packaged inside the AppImage.
Ensure QtSerialPort.framework is included in the macOS app bundle. Run macdeployqt on the .app or manually copy QtSerialPort.framework into Contents/Frameworks before creating the .dmg.
